name: vibefoundry
description: Open the VibeFoundry data-science IDE through the local bridge installed by the Python runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Local bridge for the VibeFoundry IDE
interface.longDescription: Launches the VibeFoundry pane, starts the installed Python runtime, and proxies requests between Codex and the local IDE backend. Public onboarding is handled by https://vibefoundry.ai/mcp, which installs the runtime and registers this bridge.
defaultPrompt: Show me the datasets available to this project.
